notes: PRISM RIOT application contracts for Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1), completing the project whose PRIO token, TreasuryFeeHook (0.5% fee) and distributor went live in tx 0x545df1adb27c4a2ad6de57dd3d4d28005306f1471c0002381d5518fbc1c6dd7d. Source: identity-md-launches/launch-1153-build-test-independently-review at 34e992ab plus the reviewed adaptation in this tree. No token, hook, distributor or pool is deployed; the live assets are unchanged. Constructors: FeeTreasury(IPoolManager poolManager, address owner) = live Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90 and the project owner. StakingVault(address owner, address prio) and Arena(address owner, address prio) = project owner and live PRIO 0xfd1c234972768c23bb21d655966e0b122dd67a2c. OracleAdapter(address owner, address signer) = project owner and the IMD Ethereum oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982, re-read on 2026-10-09 from api.imd.fun/oracle/requests (top-level attester and the signer of every attested request); the owner can rotate it with setSigner for future pins. The brief names the owner, 0x13afb9b5780cd9ae79c61503adb69c57845d8eac (owner of the live hook, re-read from TreasuryFeeHook.owner()), so it is written as that static address; every owner role (TwoStepOwned, no renunciation) goes to that wallet and nothing is owned by the factory. Records re-verified at block 26154821: the original tx succeeded (block 26154170), PRIO symbol PRIO, hook owner/token/poolManager/FEE_BPS(50) as expected, hook.treasury() = 0 (unbound, so no companion address exists or is invented), and the owner nonce (163) is unchanged since the launch block, so the owner has created no contract since, none of the four exists yet and this is not a duplicate. All four constructors store arguments only and call no contract, so they run on the empty rehearsal chain; sizes 10521/3788/8922/11321 bytes, no DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE/SELFDESTRUCT (test/LaunchAdaptation.t.sol and the protected floor test). The manifest contains no $owner, $token, pool, ETH funding or post-deploy callback; everything after deployment is owner-signed. After launch the owner wires the modules in the order of README 'After launch' and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, produced as (target, calldata) by script/ConfigPlan.s.sol and simulated end-to-end in LaunchAdaptationTest: A1 FeeTreasury.bindHook(hook), A2 setPrio(PRIO), A3 setSinks(StakingVault, Arena, OracleAdapter), then A4 TreasuryFeeHook.bindTreasury(FeeTreasury), which becomes permanent after the first fee; then StakingVault.setRewardFunder(FeeTreasury), Arena.setOracle(OracleAdapter), OracleAdapter.setArena(Arena), executor, reserve/spend limits, price floors, IMD pool and Intake payment. Preparation is not execution: nothing here signs or broadcasts, and the owner must check each destination against the launch receipts before signing. Economics preserved: fee ETH fills a 10%-capped operating reserve, then 30% IMD work, 30% PRIO rewards (split equally between staking and games), 40% owner; no owner advances, minting or guaranteed returns; player principal, escrow and refunds stay separate from rewards. Paid game and oracle operations stay disabled until configuration, funded reserves, prizes and the server operator are ready; the operator backs off on PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded instead of retrying.
